      "name": "build",

      "evidence": "Adds cmake/module/AddWindowsResources.cmake, edits CMakeLists.txt, and enables MinGW and MSVC CI configurations for IPC targets.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "It consolidates Windows executable resource generation into a shared CMake module and integrates Windows IPC build targets into CI."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries IPC label, updates src/ipc/libmultiprocess (+2592/-839 across 99 files), and implements Windows process spawning and socket handling.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Windows support allows the multiprocess architecture to build and run on a major supported platform, resolving libmultiprocess issues #53 and #114 and unblocking multiprocess node work (#28722)."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not alter block template construction or mining RPCs; IPC test adjustments do not touch mining interface logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR addresses general IPC OS primitives rather than mining interfaces or template generation."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/bitcoin-cli-res.rc as part of a CMake Windows resource refactor.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No JSON-RPC, REST, or bitcoin-cli functionality or interface behavior is modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test adjustments (AF_UNIX emulation in ipc_util.py) are specific to running IPC functional tests on Windows.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Changes to test helpers are domain-specific to the IPC subsystem rather than general test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to bitcoin.cpp and tool resource files only adjust Windows child process execution and resource compilation for IPC executables.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Tool logic and CLI capabilities are unchanged; the multiprocess wrapper execution fix belongs to IPC."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not change general utility libraries or shared logging/crypto primitives; changes in src/ipc/util* serve libmultiprocess.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Utility changes are internal to the libmultiprocess subtree and IPC process management."
